name: What types of finishes can Frasheski Construction match for cabinet repairs?
description: We aim to match various cabinet finishes like painted, stained, lacquered, and thermofoil surfaces for a seamless repair.

mainEntity.name: What types of finishes can Frasheski Construction match for cabinet repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction strives to match a wide range of cabinet finishes, including painted, stained, lacquered, and thermofoil surfaces. Our goal is to blend the repair seamlessly with your existing cabinetry, whether it involves color matching for a specific stain or duplicating a paint finish. Achieving an exact match can sometimes be challenging with aged or custom finishes, but we employ techniques and materials to ensure the repaired area integrates as closely as possible with the original look.
